subject: Re: Combiner bake-off status
body:
Team,

Decision from today's checkpoint, ahead of Friday's launch-review gate: we adopt the axial variant as Meridian's long-context attention for serving. Yusuf's numbers carried it — a perplexity gap our downstream evals can't detect, at 40% of the attention cost, available in both JAX and TF. Mixture is documented as the fallback if long-document quality regressions show up in production evals.

Consequences:
- Leilani closes out TF parity for axial only; no logn port.
- Nikhil's nondeterminism fix (the TF eval seeding issue) is confirmed merged.
- Milan's June integration scope is now concrete: axial kernels into Shipyard's serving stack, 32k target, plan review with Zeke's team first week of June.

Thanks all — clean bake-off, exactly what the OKR needed.

Priya
